description: Install PAN for OpenCode locally and confirm OpenCode itself lists the `pan` MCP server from .opencode/opencode.json.
why: Reality check RC8 (2026-09-10): PAN writes its MCP registration to .opencode/opencode.json — a path opencode.ai/docs/config never lists (it documents only a repo-root opencode.json), while OpenCode's loader source (packages/opencode/src/config/config.ts) reads opencode.json/.jsonc inside any .opencode directory. A file that exists on disk is not proof the runtime reads it; this scenario asks OpenCode. SKIPPED with reason when the CLI is absent.

steps.why: The installer's contract: the registration is on disk in the shape the OpenCode docs give for the mcp block.
Pins which OpenCode build the measurement was taken on; the report records stdout.

The measurement: OpenCode enumerates the servers it loaded for this workspace. If the subcommand does not exist on this build, its stderr is the evidence to adjust from — either outcome is information.
